fotos.sub: 4 real-world cases · look, assess and check the diagnosis

semPainel: The instrument becomes available at the “Prepare the instrument” step.
comoConcluir: How to finish: on the instrument (on the right), select each section and click “Measure”. You must measure all sections of the LPS.
loteDetalhe: Measures every section and shows the step as completed.

instrumento.fluxoP: P1/P2: voltage sensing. Teaching convention C1 → C2; arrows do not indicate magnitude.
instrumento.anelEnterrado: Buried ring shown schematically, visible through the ground.
instrumento.compense: Zero the test leads at the “Prepare the instrument” step; otherwise the lead resistance is added to the reading.
instrumento.avance: Go on to the “Measure between down conductors and to the BEP” step.
instrumento.criterio: Criterion: ≤ {{c}} Ω compliant · ≤ {{a}} Ω warning · {{n}}/{{total}} measured

ponto.bepAte: Indoor BEP, next to the main LV switchboard

cenario.aviso: Changing the scenario clears the measurements already recorded.

conexao-bimetalica.alt: Open test joint box with copper and aluminum conductors and no bimetallic connector
conexao-bimetalica.pergunta: What is wrong with this connection between dissimilar metals?
conexao-bimetalica.diagnostico: Copper and aluminum were left in direct contact, without a suitable bimetallic connector.
conexao-bimetalica.risco: The galvanic couple promotes corrosion, increases contact resistance and may compromise LPS continuity.
conexao-bimetalica.acao: Remake the joint with a compatible, corrosion-protected component; clean, tighten and check continuity after the repair.
conexao-bimetalica.referencia: ABNT NBR 5419-3:2026 — material compatibility and corrosion protection.

dps-inoperante.local: Main LV switchboard in the electrical room
dps-inoperante.alt: Electrical panel with surge protective devices out of service
dps-inoperante.pergunta: What condition must be checked before the surge protection can be considered operational?
dps-inoperante.diagnostico: The SPDs are out of service and cannot be considered active protection for the installation.
dps-inoperante.risco: Internal equipment is left without the intended protection against conducted overvoltages, including those associated with lightning.
dps-inoperante.acao: Replace the SPDs, check the backup protection, connections and coordination, and record the inspection of the whole assembly.
dps-inoperante.referencia: ABNT NBR 5419-4:2026 — surge protection measures; also check how NBR 5410 applies.

distancia-seguranca.alt: Conductors and building services installed very close to an LPS down conductor
distancia-seguranca.pergunta: What must be checked when other services run next to the down conductor?
distancia-seguranca.diagnostico: Conductors and building services are close to the down conductor, at less than the applicable separation distance.
distancia-seguranca.risco: The proximity may allow dangerous sparking and transfer part of the lightning current into internal installations.
distancia-seguranca.acao: Calculate the separation distance for the case, move the services away, or apply the technically specified bonding/isolation measure.
distancia-seguranca.referencia: ABNT NBR 5419-3:2026 — electrical insulation and separation distance.

continuidade-cobertura.alt: Electrical continuity test being performed on a metal roof
continuidade-cobertura.pergunta: What does this photo prove, and what still needs to be recorded?
continuidade-cobertura.diagnostico: The image documents a continuity test being carried out on the roof; on its own, it does not show that the result was compliant.
continuidade-cobertura.risco: Without identifying the points, method, instrument and readings, a photo alone does not support the technical assessment.
continuidade-cobertura.acao: Record in the report the tested points, preparation, instrument, test current, readings, applicable criterion and conclusion.
continuidade-cobertura.referencia: ABNT NBR 5419-3:2026 — continuity verification and inspection records.

laudo.metodo: Method: ABNT NBR 5419-3 — LPS inspection and maintenance

parecer.conforme: All {{n}} tested sections showed electrical continuity within the criterion (R ≤ {{c}} Ω). The LPS MEETS the continuity requirement of ABNT NBR 5419-3 on the inspection date.
parecer.incompleto: INCOMPLETE inspection: {{lidos}} of {{n}} sections measured. Measure all planned sections before issuing the report.
parecer.nao-conforme: {{nc}} continuity nonconformity(ies) found. The LPS DOES NOT MEET the ABNT NBR 5419-3 requirement until the indicated sections are repaired and re-measured.

aberto.causa: Broken down conductor or fully open connection.
aberto.acao: Locate the interrupted section, remake the conductor/connection and re-measure.

corrosao.causa: Corroded connection or deteriorated splice along the path.
corrosao.acao: Clean/remake the connection (compression connector or exothermic weld) and re-measure.

aperto.acao: Retighten to the specified torque, treat the surface and re-measure.
